description: Personnel with security responsibilities do not receive specialized training appropriate to their roles. This signal indicates that administrators, developers, or security personnel may lack skills needed for their specific security duties.
applicability: Applicable to personnel with specialized security responsibilities. Includes system administrators, security officers, developers, incident responders, and other roles requiring specific security competencies.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through role-based training program review, specialized training records, and competency assessment verification.
